answer: Each identity grows one cedar: a root of verified jobs adding exactly one ring per epoch, key-bound, so it cannot be bought, rushed, or lent. A claim must carry its plume, a trace of the cedar's rings that any peer can recompute from the record. A juniper gate admits the claim only when its rings belong to no other identity; a ring shared by two heads triggers twin-ring collapse, discarding both claims and burning their rings. A farm of N heads must therefore grow N cedars ring by ring across epochs, and no ring, plume, or gate pass can be pooled across clones.
